English
【國際處】2027-2028年赴日本姊妹校(日語組) 交換生第二次聯合甄選作業簡章，收件至115年9月16日(三)12時止
2026-09-09
李星霖
說明：
一、甄選作業簡章及姊妹校一覽表，點選「
2027-2028年赴日本姐妹校（日語組）第二次交換生聯合甄選作業簡章
」。
二、申請日期自115年9月14日(一)至115年9月17日(四)中午12時止。
三、本系申請同學請於
9月16日(三)12:00前
備妥申請表（上網填寫後列印）及相關資料，送至財金系辦B1001，由系辦彙整後逕送國際處。
四、業務承辦人：交流組吳舒宇，分機3759。
五、本活動與聯合國永續發展目標SDG4(優質教育)及SDG17(夥伴關係)連結。
Submission of the 2027-2028 Tamkang University Exchange Students Internal Screening Guide. (Japanese Group)
Description:
I. Please click the　＂
The 2027-2028 Tamkang University Exchange Students Internal Screening Guide (Japanese Group)
＂to view the documents.
II. The application period is from September 14, 2026 (Monday) to September 17, 2026 (Thursday), before 12:00 PM.
III. Applicants should complete and submit the application form
(fill it out online and print it)
, along with the required supporting documents, to the Department Office (B1001)
by 12:00 noon on Wednesday, September 16
. The Department Office will compile the applications and forward them directly to the Office of International and Cross-Strait Affairs.
IV.  Person in charge: Ms. Aurora Wu, extension 3759.
VI. This program is connected with Sustainable Development Goals, the United Nations: SDG 4 (Quality Education) and SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals).
